long_biography.plain_text:
Sonomatic began developing non-destructive inspection methods in the 1980s. It now combines specialist testing with integrity engineering, robotics and equipment design for subsea and industrial assets. Its platform grew from ultrasonic inspection into a broader international service business, giving Cesan an ownership interest centred on engineering expertise rather than consumer products.

Cesan, an Argentine resident of Monaco born in May 1952, became Sonomatic's controlling shareholder in March 2024. Her registered interest exceeds three quarters of both equity and voting power. She does not hold a directorship; the company's operating mandates sit with other named officers. The preceding controller left on the same date, but the transfer's legal basis and any relationship between the two individuals remain undisclosed.
